notes: Al Jazeera Arabic liveblog. RTL page with JSON-LD plus a nested VideoObject whose uploadDate must not outrank the article date. Published was annotated 2026-07-27 originally, read straight off `datePublished: 2026-07-27T21:02Z`. That is the UTC rendering of an instant that is 00:02 on the 28th in Doha, and every other thing the page says — the canonical URL `/2026/7/28/`, the byline `Published On 28/7/2026` — dates it to the 28th. Corrected, and it is now the case that pins the timezone reconciliation in resolve.ts.
